**Deletion attempt failed:** Calling `chat.delete` on this message consistently returned `{"ok":false,"error":"cant_delete_message"}`, across multiple variations (different auth header styles, channel by ID vs name, with/without `as_user`). To confirm this was a permissions issue rather than a request-format issue, I posted a test message as the bot and successfully deleted it — proving the bot can only delete messages it authored itself, not messages authored by other users (U_KENJI in this case). This bot's token lacks the elevated `chat:write.admin` scope required to delete other users' messages.

**Outcome:** The message was correctly identified, but I could not complete the deletion due to insufficient token permissions. An admin-level token/scope would be required to delete this message on behalf of another user.
